violation_type.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Self- Instructional up to 80% (26 TAC §747.1309(i))
violation_type.short_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Self- Instructional up to 80%
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not meet the requirements of obtaining at least 6 hours of annual training in a classroom or virtual classroom setting.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregiver did not meet the requirements of obtaining at least 6 hours of annual training in a classroom or virtual classroom setting.
The director lacked 6 hours of instructor-led training to complete last years annual training.
The primary caregiver was lacking 4 out of 6 in person or instructor-led training hours for the most recent completed training year.
